summary: A PageShell header with an icon tile before the title, a count badge after it, a titleExtra badge and an action button.
use: Product screens that name the list and how many records it holds ("Deals, 128", "Tasks, 12") without replacing the PageShell header.
spec: Frame is a flush full `Card` holding the `PageShell`
`{#snippet titleExtra()}` renders `<Badge tone="warning" subtle>3 overdue</Badge>`; `{#snippet actions()}` renders a small filled `New deal` button
Body is a `Card full` with a placeholder line
